about_the_game:
Get ready to slide, slip, and stretch your brain in Me Resbala! — a fast-paced puzzle game where every move counts more than you think.

Solve quick yet clever challenges across levels full of slippery surfaces, exploding crates, and tricky obstacles. The mechanic? Slide in a direction until you hit something... and think carefully before you do!

Two modes, two mindsets

  • Classic Mode: Take your time and solve each puzzle with as many moves as needed. Use logic to find the smartest solution.

  • Ninja Mode: Just one move allowed. Yep — you only get one shot to nail the perfect sequence. Fast, precise, and unforgiving.

Score-based progression

Every level is scored. Did you do well? Could you do better? Replay and refine your strategy to reach the highest score on each stage. The goal isn’t just to finish — it’s to finish in style!

Key Features

  • Over 100 short but addictive levels

  • Two ways to play: Classic and Ninja Mode

  • Scoring system that rewards smart solutions

  • Unique retro visual style with hand-drawn animations

  • Perfect for quick sessions... or obsessively chasing a perfect run

  • Developed solo and streamed live on Twitch and YouTube (Casanova Dev)
